POCKET FIELD NOTES

A few numbers.
A whole new world.

Play the clip, type what you hear, then check. Every workout has ten questions. Missed questions get a second round.

十 · shí / ten
十二 = 12. 二十 = 20. 二十二 = 22.
零 · líng / zero
一百零五 = 105. The zero tells you a place is missing.
万 · wàn / ten thousand
一万 = 10,000. 三万 = 30,000.
元 · 角 · 分 / money
三元五角 = ¥3.50. 三元零五分 = ¥3.05.
两点 · liǎng diǎn / two o’clock
十四点零五分 = 14:05. Enter times using the 24-hour clock.
幺 · yāo / one on the phone
Phone strings use 幺 for 1. Enter all 11 digits.

Audio is synthetic Mandarin, not a native-speaker recording. Pinyin shows dictionary tones; natural speech can change 一 / 不 and consecutive third tones. This focused gym is practice, not a proficiency assessment.
